topicName: What is an entity in JPA? How do you define an entity class?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is an entity in JPA? How do you define an entity class?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"In JPA, an entity represents a table in a relational database. An entity class is a Java class that maps to this table. Each instance of an entity class corresponds to a row in the table.  Entities are managed by the JPA provider (like Hibernate) and are used to persist data to the database."}]
